upload.note: 0 current-run checkpoints externally backed up; per-milestone HF attempt + sha256 verify mandatory

policy.archive_rule: after each milestone eval, if >=3 milestones exist or free < 35GB, move the oldest milestone(s) beyond the newest 2 to the archive; record sha256; never delete
policy.external_upload: attempt HF per milestone; mark external only after sha256 verify; failures keep archive and set external_backup_pending
policy.refresh: re-run df before/after every milestone and before GPU-low actions
policy.archive_persistence: same_host_move_not_backup — the /root overlay is on the rented instance; persistence across pod rebuild/restart is NOT confirmed
policy.external_rule: checkpoint without an external sha256-verified copy => external=no_external_backup; per-milestone upload attempt is mandatory; record failure reasons (e.g. HF 401) instead of silently skipping
